Monstrosity · 1 hex · SM +0 Death Dog [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: mundane land animals; answers Death Dog (SRD 5.1)]

A two-headed hound the colour of dust, running the dry country in pairs and hating everything upright. Both heads bite, both heads watch, and neither can be approached blind. What kills travellers is rarely the wound itself but what grows in it afterwards, which is slow, visible, and does not stop on its own.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/death-dog.gct
  • Independent build total: 38 points of racial traits plus 12 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Death Dog (SRD 5.1). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Movement: ground Move 6 (primary). The published Move folds this creature's Enhanced Move into a single figure.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • The disease is priced as a 30-point disabling ability so the rating path can see it; see review/policy/cer-scope-policy.md.
